component.name: LDM Download Manager
component.summary: Multi-connection downloader with browser video detection

description.p: LDM is a Linux download manager. It splits HTTP(S)/FTP downloads into multiple connections, resumes interrupted transfers, schedules a queue, and works with a browser extension that detects HLS, DASH and progressive video on web pages.
The browser extension and native messaging need host-side integration; see the README.
